errors.text: The predicted effect has the wrong sign: the target reports an approximately 12% increase in lattice thermal conductivity with SRO, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts suppression.
The hypothesis replaces HfNbTaTiZr and its HfTi/TiZr ordered clusters with MoNbTaW, omitting the target's B2-like structures and percolating high-conductivity pathways.

Diffuse antiphase boundaries generated by dislocation glide are incorrectly transferred from mechanical-strengthening evidence to phonon transport; the cited studies provide no thermal-conductivity evidence.
The proposed mechanism misses the target mechanisms of reduced lattice distortion, reduced atomic displacement, percolative transport, and modified high-frequency phonon density of states.
The claim that phonon propagation creates or encounters glide-generated DAPBs conflates dislocation-mediated structural disruption with equilibrium phonon scattering.
